title: feat(plugin-auth): register an AI service account and mint its API key
body:
Part of #31739

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Clause-② measured: two new auth doors (`POST /api/v1/auth/service-account/register`, `POST /api/v1/auth/service-account/create-key`), two new `sys_user` actions (`register_service_account`, `create_service_account_key`), and four new `@objectstack/core` root exports (`readRequestedApiKeyExpiry`, `signApiKeyExpiry`, `ApiKeyExpiryRefusal`, `ApiKeyExpiryCeilingRefusal`). No `packages/spec` file, stored column or published shape changes; no export is removed or retyped. The two filters (break-glass guard, upgrade-report audience) leave out only rows of the agent kind, and only this PR's door (or a seed) writes one, so no existing accept-set narrows. `POST /api/v1/keys` answers exactly as before (its ceiling code stays the runtime's, ledgered there). Changeset level `patch` (Metadata-protocol none).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增两个入口：组织管理员或平台管理员注册 AI 服务账号（`principal_kind = agent` 的 `sys_user`，归属一位负责人，占位邮箱，组织里的普通成员）；负责人或管理员为账号签发 API 密钥（绑定账号所在组织，过期上限与 `POST /keys` 同一规则）。`sys_user` 上加了对应的两个按钮。
- 为什么改：ADR-0151 D1、D4，三步拆分的第三步前半（PR-1 #31779、PR-2 #31867 已合并）；挂起、恢复、换负责人、退役与吊销/恢复密钥在 3b（`Fixes #31739`）。
- 风险与回滚：两个入口只认登录会话（API 密钥一律 401），所以账号不能注册账号、也不能给自己签密钥；注册的两次写在一个事务里。破窗守卫与升级报告收件人不再把账号算作管理员。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/service-account-doors.ts`（权限判断、事务、签发），`auth-plugin.ts` 里的两个挂载，`last-admin-guard.ts#resolveAdminUserIds` 与 `upgrade-report-delivery.ts#withoutAgentAccounts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/service-account-doors.test.ts src/last-admin-guard.agent-account.test.ts`，应见 27 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 评审）。

## What changes

- **Register** (`POST /api/v1/auth/service-account/register`, body `name`, optional `ownerId`). The caller is read from the better-auth session only. Authority: an organization administrator (owner or admin grade on an active membership) of the caller's active organization, or a platform administrator. The owner defaults to the caller and must be an active member of that organization. One transaction writes the `sys_user` row (`principal_kind: 'agent'`, `accountable_user_id` the owner, a generated `@placeholder.invalid` email, `email_verified: false`, `source: 'env_native'`) through the engine, so PR-1's row guard judges it, and the vendor's server-only `addMember` as a plain `member`. A refused membership rolls the row back. `201 { userId, name, principalKind, organizationId, ownerId }`.
- **Create key** (`POST /api/v1/auth/service-account/create-key`, body `userId`, optional `name`, `expires_at`). Authority: the account's owner (while an active member of the account's organization), an administrator of the account's organization, or a platform administrator. The key's `active_organization_id` is the account's organization, never the caller's or the body's. Expiry is signed by the same rule as `POST /api/v1/keys`, now one function pair in `@objectstack/core` that `runtime/domains/keys.ts` also calls (no behaviour change there; its 83 tests are unchanged and green). The raw key is returned once; only its hash is stored, and neither is logged.
- **Refusals** reuse existing codes: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` (no session, or an API key only), the held-session `403`, `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` (`name` required or too long, `ownerId` not a member, `expires_at` past the ceiling), `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (an `expires_at` that is no date or not in the future), `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` for an id that is not an account (a person's id included), `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` for an account with no active membership, `503` when the authority read fails. **Accepted deviation from `POST /keys`:** the create-key ceiling answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` at `expires_at` with `POST /keys`'s message, where `POST /keys` answers `400 API_KEY_EXPIRY_TOO_LONG`. That code is ledgered under `@objectstack/runtime`; stamping it from plugin-auth would need a ledger row in `packages/spec`, which this card does not edit.
- **The name carries the purpose for now.** There is no purpose column: one would be a Metadata-protocol change and needs its own card (open debt on #31739).
- **The placeholder email** is `<random>@placeholder.invalid`: `.invalid` is reserved (RFC 2606), so it is never deliverable and never collides with a real address. Pinned: two accounts get distinct placeholders, both in that domain.
- **Neither administrator count includes an account.** `resolveAdminUserIds` (the break-glass guard, both populations) drops agent rows after enumeration, so an account holding `admin_full_access` and an owner grade does not let the last person administrator be banned or lose the grant. The upgrade-report audience and `auditOwnerOrganization`'s administrator list drop agent rows the same way.
- **The kind is read in the resolver, not `USER_BAN_FIELDS`** (F3): an account's standing comes from `principal_kind` on its `sys_user` row in `resolveUserAuthzGrants` (PR-2), and a ban of the account refuses its key through the existing ban predicate; the ban field list is unchanged.
- **Actions.** `register_service_account` (list toolbar; visible to platform admins and organization owners/admins) and `create_service_account_key` (record; visible on an agent row to administrators and to its owner), with a result dialog like `create_api_key`. Labels in en and the 10 shipped locales.
- **Ledgers.** Two rows in `auth-route-ledger.ts` (ObjectStack mount, server-only) and the conformance list. The tenant-audit census and its page now count the door's two engine writes (280 → 282).
- **Docs.** `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` (the AI service account, unattended track) and `content/docs/permissions/index.mdx` (AI service accounts).

## Tests

New, all green:
- plugin-auth `service-account-doors.test.ts` (21, real ObjectQL + SQLite with PR-1's row guard): the authority matrix for both doors; the written rows; distinct placeholders; owner default and owner rules; rollback when the membership is refused; 503 on an unreadable authority read; the key's organization taken from the account; 404 for a person; 409 for an account with no membership; the owner who left; the ceiling; a past date; `userId` required.
- plugin-auth `last-admin-guard.agent-account.test.ts` (6, real engine): the enumeration names the person only, for both populations; banning or revoking the last person administrator is refused although an account holds the same grant and an owner grade. CONTROLs: a person with the grant, a person with the owner grade, banning the account itself.
- plugin-security `upgrade-report-delivery.test.ts` (+3): an account is never a recipient and never an organization's administrator there.
- dogfood `service-account-register-key.dogfood.test.ts` (8, showcase stack over HTTP): anonymous 401, member 403 with nothing written; admin registers (rows checked); an API-key caller 401; another member 403 on create-key; the owner mints; the key is admitted at the data door; the account's own key mints nothing (401 here, 403 at `POST /keys`); a person's id 404; ban refuses the key as a made-up key is refused, unban restores it.

Forced test edits:
- `upgrade-report-delivery.test.ts`: the engine double's `matches` learns `{ $in: [...] }` (the new by-id read).
- `auth-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`: the two routes added to the hand-written `own` list.
- Forced census edit: `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` and `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md` count the door's two engine writes (write call sites 280 → 282; the decidable, undecidable and elevation-undecidable figures move with them).

## Acceptance notes

- Registration, key mint, owner rules and the two administrator counts land here; the lifecycle doors (suspend, resume, set-owner, retire, owner-leaves auto-suspend, revoke-key and restore-key) land in 3b, which closes the card.
- `docs/adr/**` is untouched; the ADR-0151 status amendment is the seat's.

## Verification

- Suites (under `os-verify-lock`): core 3345, runtime 10545, plugin-auth 4530, plugin-security 6094, platform-objects 1934 passed; `check:test-typecheck` green in all five.
- Dogfood: whole package under the lock: 443 files passed, 3 skipped; 3677 tests passed, 42 skipped.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 109 of 109 derived families run, all exit 0 (a DERIVED zero). eslint on the changed files: clean.
- Ablations (each restored, `git diff HEAD` empty after): 7 of 7 negative pins go red when their rule is removed:
  - the last-admin filter: 3 red (enumeration, ban, revoke);
  - the upgrade-report filter: 3 red;
  - register authority: 2 red; create-key authority: 2 red;
  - the one transaction: 1 red (rollback);
  - the agent-kind check: 1 red (404 for a person);
  - the membership check: 1 red (409 when retired).
  The session-only read has no alternative branch to remove (the doors call `getSession`, which never resolves an API key); it is pinned from outside by the dogfood's two `401`s for a key caller.
